song.title: Dead Leaves And The Dirty Ground

guitar.notes: Jack White's red Airline JB Hutto fiberglass guitar is one of the most iconic and well-documented instruments of 2000s rock.

tone.target: raw garage-blues crunch with nasty fuzz edge
tone.profile: raw garage-blues crunch with nasty fuzz edge
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain utilizing Fuzz/Distortion into a British combo amp (UK 45) with minimal reverb to capture the dirty, lo-fi sound of early garage rock.

rig.name: The White Stripes - Dead Leaves And The Dirty Ground - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up stray hum and noise inherent in raw garage recordings.
Provide a slight initial grit and boost for the verse clean sections without sounding polished.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used here to simulate an early, slightly broken tube preamp tone rather than pure dirt.

alternatives.reason: A simpler boost might be too clean.

blocks.purpose: Deliver the core aggressive fuzz and nasty edge required for the chorus/main riffs.

alternatives.reason: Might be too structured or bright.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the sound of a small, overdriven British combo amp (Plexi/garage crunch) with strong mid-focus.

alternatives.reason: Too clean and American sounding for the desired grit.

blocks.purpose: Provide a classic British cabinet tone that complements the UK 45 amp model.
